description: The playa, the festival of free-for-all lots beside the Commons, round the effigy. lots: what's up and where (what: a street like Esplanade, C, 4:30, or art). build: a free kit piece, up to 8 at once (what: "arch sea blue on lot 120", "canvas with design bunting on lot 120", "sign saying EVERY DOOR on lot 120", "object doorbell on lot 122"). raise: stake out something big built together from materials (what: "temple on lot 40"; empty lists them). chip_in: materials from your pack (what: "4 posts and 2 rope for b1"). admire, take_down, rebuild: a piece (p12). give: "p14 to mira". camp: "Ember on lot 12 vibe warm" claims a lot for your crew; crew: join or form one ("Ember Camp"). offer: a few words on a plank for the effigy, one a day. storage: your pieces put away. Chapter: plazmi://skill/playa (/skill/playa on the site).
